governance.parent: Staatliche Museen zu Berlin, Stiftung Preußischer Kulturbesitz

red_tape.note: A 2020 Wissenschaftsrat review of the Prussian Cultural Heritage Foundation says deep hierarchies and unclear decision structures make processes lengthy and opaque, most clearly at the Staatliche Museen, and a footnote adds that the Nationalgalerie, which includes the Neue Nationalgalerie, has further hierarchy levels.

corrected.basis: Governance: StiftPKG section 1 makes the Stiftung Preußischer Kulturbesitz a public-law foundation, its section 7 and 12 give the Stiftungsrat the budget and the ministries approval and the Bundesrechnungshof audit, and the Statut page 2 makes the foundation employer of all staff of the Staatliche Museen; red tape: Wissenschaftsrat report Drs. 8520-20, section C.II.4, PDF pages 16 to 18.
